resources.string: Reads the selected account on Questrade\'s order screen to show its cash.
In App info, open the ⋮ menu and tap \"Allow restricted settings\". Android needs this before it lets you turn on the next step.
Turn on Questrade Cash Overlay so it can read the account on Questrade\'s order screen.
Allow notifications so the app can tell you when a login needs reconnecting.
Set battery use to \"No restrictions\" so HyperOS doesn\'t stop the daily refresh.
Turn on Autostart for this app in Security, then tick the box below.
